2026-07-02.title: Kawagoe Little Edo Half-Day → Higashi-Ginza + Odaiba Evening

2026-07-04.title: SMALL WORLDS + Doraemon Exhibition + Shin-Yokohama + Ado Concert

haneda.name: Haneda Airport (International Terminal)
haneda.description: Arrive in Japan; immigration via Visit Japan Web KIOSK + baggage claim + Suica card exchange

tabinos-hamamatsucho.name: Hotel Tabinos Hamamatsucho
tabinos-hamamatsucho.description: Directly connected to Takeiba Stn (Yurikamome); modern design; best Haneda access (10 min); check-in + rest

divercity-evening.name: DiverCity Dinner + Flexible Evening
divercity-evening.description: Takeiba→Aomi (10 min)→DiverCity; dinner 18:00–20:00; if energized: Gundam Night Show (20:00) + Aqua Symphony (20:30); if tired: return hotel; DiverCity Official

gundam-night-optional-26.name: Unicorn Gundam Night Show (6/26 Optional)
gundam-night-optional-26.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE (retires Aug 2026)! [Optional] Free; every 30 min from 19:00; Official Site

aqua-symphony-optional-26.name: Tokyo Aqua Symphony (6/26 Optional)
aqua-symphony-optional-26.description: [Optional] Free; Odaiba Marine Park; 15–20 min walk from DiverCity; 10-min fountain show; 20:00 or 21:00 show; Official Site

hotel-breakfast.name: Hotel Tabinos Breakfast
hotel-breakfast.description: Restaurant connected to Takeiba Station; fuel up for the full day

movement-to-ariake.name: Takeiba → Ariake Tennos-no-Mori (Yurikamome)
movement-to-ariake.description: Yurikamome Line; Takeiba→Ariake Tennos-no-Mori Stn; ~15–20 min

gundam-stamp-1-odaiba-kaihin.name: [Stamp ①] Odaiba-Kaihinkoen Stn (Optional)
gundam-stamp-1-odaiba-kaihin.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); stamp stand inside station; hop off Yurikamome, stamp, re-board next train; only 2–3 min

gundam-stamp-2-waterbus.name: [Stamp ②] Water Bus Terminal (Optional)
gundam-stamp-2-waterbus.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); 5 min walk from Odaiba-Kaihinkoen Stn; Daiba 1-4-1, waterfront pier; stamp and walk back to station

gundam-stamp-3-daiba-station.name: [Stamp ③] Daiba Station (Optional)
gundam-stamp-3-daiba-station.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); stamp stand inside station; hop off Yurikamome, stamp, re-board next train; only 2–3 min

gundam-stamp-4-shiokaze.name: [Stamp ④] Shiokaze Park Observation Deck (Optional)
gundam-stamp-4-shiokaze.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); 5–10 min walk from Daiba Stn; stamp at observation deck with sea view; return to station after

small-worlds.name: 🎮 SMALL WORLDS TOKYO
small-worlds.description: [Must-do] World's largest miniature theme park; 3 min from Ariake Tennos-no-Mori Stn; 2.5–3 hrs; or swap with Tokyo Dream Park Doraemon exhibition; Official Site

movement-to-ichiba-mae.name: Ariake → Ichiba-mae (Yurikamome)
movement-to-ichiba-mae.description: Yurikamome Line; very short ~5 min; direct to Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara

toyosu-sengyoku-mankara.name: 🍱 Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara
toyosu-sengyoku-mankara.description: [Must-do] Gourmet food hall at Toyosu Market waterfront complex; seafood bowls, soba, ramen, BBQ; ~1.5 hr dining; Official Site

movement-back-to-ariake.name: Ichiba-mae → Ariake (Yurikamome)
movement-back-to-ariake.description: Yurikamome Line; ~5 min return after lunch

tokyo-dream-park.name: 🎡 Tokyo Dream Park
tokyo-dream-park.description: [Must-do] Ariake; 6F rooftop plaza + Shohei Ohtani golden statue FREE; 100% Doraemon Exhibition ¥2,400 (weekend pre-sale, optional); 2–3 hrs; Official Site

movement-to-odaiba.name: Ariake → Aomi (Yurikamome)
movement-to-odaiba.description: Yurikamome Line; ~15 min to DiverCity area

divercity-afternoon.name: 🎮 DiverCity Afternoon (Flexible)
divercity-afternoon.description: Choose freely: ✅ Unko Museum (1–1.5h) ✅ Gundam Base Tokyo 5F (free) ✅ Unicorn Gundam statue photo ✅ Shopping & café; ✅ Stamp Rally (6/8–7/12): collect at DiverCity 2F + 5 other Odaiba spots → instant on-site lottery machine (win = collect prize right there, tourist-friendly!); DiverCity Official

divercity-dinner.name: 🍽️ DiverCity Dinner
divercity-dinner.description: Wide range of restaurants inside the mall; dine as the Gundam transitions from day to night lighting

gundam-night.name: 🌃 Unicorn Gundam Night Show
gundam-night.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE — retiring end of August 2026 after nearly 9 years! Free; WALL-G shows every 30 min (19:00–21:30): 19:00 Gundam 45th Anniversary Special Movie · 20:00 UNICORN Special Movie · 21:30 GUNDAM:BEYOND; recommended: 20:00 show; Stamp Rally (6/8–7/12) at DiverCity 2F — collect for chance to win limited RG Gundam; Official Site

movement-to-odaiba-bay.name: Aomi → Odaiba Marine Park (walk)
movement-to-odaiba-bay.description: 15–20 min walk behind DiverCity; scenic Tokyo Bay views along the way

aqua-symphony.name: 💦 Tokyo Aqua Symphony Night Fountain Show
aqua-symphony.description: Free; 3 min from Odaiba Stn; 10 shows/day (11–21:00, no 16:00); recommended 21:00 show; ~10 min; Official Site

movement-return-to-hotel.name: Odaiba → Takeiba (return to hotel)
movement-return-to-hotel.description: Yurikamome Line; Odaiba→Takeiba; ~20 min; return to Hotel Tabinos to rest

hotel-breakfast-28.name: Hotel Tabinos Breakfast + Pack Up
hotel-breakfast-28.description: Last breakfast at Hotel Tabinos (checkout today); fuel up and tidy luggage; store bags before heading to Tsukiji

movement-hotel-to-sangubashi.name: Takeiba → Sangubashi (transit)
movement-hotel-to-sangubashi.description: JR Yamanote Line northbound; ~30 min; heading to Meiji Shrine north entrance

movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north.name: Sangubashi → Meiji Shrine North Gate (walk)
movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north.description: Walk ~30 min through greenery to the north entrance

harajuku-meiji-shrine.name: ⛩️ Meiji Shrine – Forest Walk
harajuku-meiji-shrine.description: Japan's most important Shinto shrine; free; enter north gate, exit east; serene forested path; tranquil contrast to the city; Official Site

harajuku-omotesando.name: 🚶 Omotesando (表參道)
harajuku-omotesando.description: Tokyo's premier upscale shopping street; LV, Gucci, Prada flagships; beautiful architecture; connects directly from Meiji Shrine east exit

movement-omotesando-to-takeshita.name: Omotesando → Takeshita-dori (walk)
movement-omotesando-to-takeshita.description: 10–15 min walk; Omotesando area straight to Takeshita-dori entrance

harajuku-takeshita.name: 🚶 Takeshita-dori – 1.5 hrs
harajuku-takeshita.description: World-famous Harajuku youth fashion street; H&M, Forever 21, Japanese indie shops, crepes, accessories; lively crowds; full 1.5 hrs to snack & explore; Info

harajuku-lunch.name: 🍽️ Harajuku Lunch [Flexible]
harajuku-lunch.description: Free choice around Takeshita-dori or Omotesando; Eggs 'n Things, BAPE Cafe and many more options; refuel before heading to Kichijoji

movement-harajuku-to-kichijoji.name: Harajuku → Kichijoji (transit)
movement-harajuku-to-kichijoji.description: JR Yamanote Line Harajuku→Shibuya (1 stop, ~2 min) → Keio Inokashira Line Shibuya→Kichijoji (Express, ~26 min); ~30 min total, 1 transfer

kichijoji-petitmura-temarinooshiro.name: 🏰 Kichijoji Petit Mura + CAPOON + Temari no Oshiro Cat Cafe
kichijoji-petitmura-temarinooshiro.description: Fairy-tale village complex; 2-33-2 Kichijoji Honcho, Musashino; 7-min walk from Kichijoji North Exit; 🍵 CAPOON Matcha: stone-ground matcha drinks & desserts (20 min); 🏰 Temari no Oshiro (Castle Cat Café): castle-themed, ~20 cats, 2-storey; flat weekend entry ¥1,800/person, no time limit; light food menu available; walk-ins welcome; open 10:00–21:00 year-round; Official Site

kichijoji-soratobusakana-lunch.name: ☕ Kuusougai Café — Flying Fish (Afternoon Tea)
kichijoji-soratobusakana-lunch.description: Fantasy-themed café; 2-34-9 Kichijoji Honcho; 7-min walk from Kichijoji South Exit (Park Exit) along Nakamichi-dori; picture-book artist atelier concept; specialty drinks & desserts; ⚠️ No lunch set on weekends — desserts and drinks only on Sundays; open 11:00–19:00 daily; Info article

kichijoji-inokashira-park.name: 🌿 Inokashira Park – Lakeside Stroll [Flexible]
kichijoji-inokashira-park.description: 5-min walk from Flying Fish Café; free entry; lakeside walk + optional swan boat rental; most beautiful natural scenery in Kichijoji; Park Info

movement-kichijoji-to-shinjuku.name: Kichijoji → Shinjuku West (transit)
movement-kichijoji-to-shinjuku.description: JR Chuo Line (Rapid) Kichijoji→Shinjuku (~22 min); 1-min walk from West Exit to Kagawa Ippuku; ~30 min total

shinjuku-kagawa-ippuku.name: 🍜 Kagawa Ippuku Nishi-Shinjuku (Dinner)
shinjuku-kagawa-ippuku.description: Sanuki udon specialty; 7-9-15 Nishi-Shinjuku, Daikan Plaza Bizness Kiyota Bldg 1F; 1-min walk from Toei Oedo Line Shinjuku-Nishiguchi Stn D5 exit; Sun/holidays 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Official Site

movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae.name: Nishi-Shinjuku → Tochomae (after dinner)
movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae.description: Walk from Kagawa Ippuku to Tokyo Metropolitan Govt Bldg: ~10–12 min (~850m); or Toei Oedo Line Shinjuku-Nishiguchi→Tochomae (1 stop, ~3 min); must arrive by 20:00

tokyo-night-light-projection.name: ✨ Tokyo Night Light – Shinjuku Projection Mapping Show [Must-see]
tokyo-night-light-projection.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building (connected to Tochomae Stn); massive outdoor projection mapping show; every night 20:00–21:00 (confirm before going); free; breathtaking light art; Official Site

movement-return-hotel-28.name: Tochomae → Takeiba (return to hotel)
movement-return-hotel-28.description: Marunouchi Line; ~25 min; return to Hotel Tabinos; rest up for early Shinkansen

hotel-breakfast-29.name: Hotel Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-29.description: Restaurant at Takeiba Station; fuel up before teamLab

movement-hotel-to-teamlab.name: Takeiba → teamLab Borderless (transit)
movement-hotel-to-teamlab.description: Marunouchi Line Takeiba→Akasaka-Mitsuke (~5 min) + 10 min walk to Azabudai Hills

teamlab-29.name: 🎨 teamLab Borderless – Azabudai Hills [Highlight]
teamlab-29.description: [Must-do] Boundary-less immersive digital art; interconnected rooms; light & interactive installations; 3 hrs recommended; must pre-book online; Book Tickets

azabudai-optional-shrines.name: ⛩️ Azabudai Shrines [Optional]
azabudai-optional-shrines.description: [Flexible] After teamLab: if time & energy → quick photo at Reiyukai Shakaden + Nishikubo Hachimangu (15 min); rushed/tired → skip, head to Tokyo Stn

movement-azabudai-to-yuzawa.name: Azabudai → Echigo-Yuzawa (Shinkansen)
movement-azabudai-to-yuzawa.description: Marunouchi Line Akasaka-Mitsuke→Tokyo Stn (~15 min) + walk to Shinkansen; Joetsu Shinkansen Tokyo→Echigo-Yuzawa 13:00–14:00; pre-book reserved seats (ekinet); enjoy ekiben on board

yuzawa-arrival.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Arrival + Onsen
yuzawa-arrival.description: Explore around the station; hotel hot spring bath; foot bath; cafés; enjoy the resort atmosphere; recharge before dinner

yuzawa-hotel.name: 湯沢グランドホテル (Yuzawa Grand Hotel)
yuzawa-hotel.description: 3 min walk from station; large communal onsen bath + outdoor bath; all-you-can-eat dinner & breakfast (Japanese/Western/Chinese); free luggage storage for 6/30 Kiyotsu trip; Official Site

yuzawa-checkout.name: Hotel Checkout + Luggage Storage
yuzawa-checkout.description: Early checkout; hotel offers free luggage storage; check out and head to Kiyotsu Gorge

movement-yuzawa-to-kiyotsu.name: Yuzawa → Kiyotsu Gorge (bus)
movement-yuzawa-to-kiyotsu.description: Express bus; 3 min walk from station; ~30 min; alight at Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel stop

kiyotsu-gorge-morning.name: 🏞️ Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel ～Mirror Reflection～ [Highlight]
kiyotsu-gorge-morning.description: One of Japan's three great gorges; 750m observation tunnel with stunning 'water mirror' art installation at the far end (best on sunny days); ~1.5 hrs; arrive early for fewer crowds; Official Site

yuzawa-lunch-rest.name: 🍱 Yuzawa Lunch + Onsen Break
yuzawa-lunch-rest.description: Around Yuzawa Station; try onigiri bomb (bakudan onigiri) or foot bath at HATAGO Isen; enjoy the resort vibe before Shinkansen departure

movement-yuzawa-to-niigata.name: Yuzawa → Niigata (Shinkansen)
movement-yuzawa-to-niigata.description: Joetsu Shinkansen Echigo-Yuzawa→Niigata; ~45 min; pre-book reserved seat; enjoy ekiben (station bento) on board

niigata-arrival-rest.name: Niigata Station Arrival + Rest
niigata-arrival-rest.description: Store bags at coin lockers or hotel; relax at station mall Popia Bandai or a café; recharge for the afternoon

niigata-hotel-checkin.name: Niigata Hotel Check-in
niigata-hotel-checkin.description: Check in; rest and freshen up before evening festival activities

niigata-afternoon-activities.name: Niigata City Afternoon
niigata-afternoon-activities.description: Explore Niigata city; local food, shopping around Bandai area or Furumachi Arcade; enjoy the relaxed pace of Niigata

kahara-shrine-first-night.name: Kanbara Shrine – Festival Opening Night
kahara-shrine-first-night.description: Kanbara Matsuri (蒲原まつり) opening night; traditional Niigata summer festival dating back 300+ years; stalls, food, performances, mikoshi; free admission; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

zoushuukan.name: 蔵春閣 (Zoshunkan)
zoushuukan.description: Former Ito Hikohachi villa; elegant Meiji-era architecture; Japanese garden; Info

shimizu-en.name: 清水園 (Shimizu-en Garden)
shimizu-en.description: Traditional Japanese garden formerly attached to the Mizoguchi clan in Shibata; peaceful strolling garden; Official Site

shibata-castle.name: 新発田城 (Shibata Castle)
shibata-castle.description: Japan's 100 Famous Castles #17; unique three-shachi (dolphin-fish) golden turrets; free exterior; restored buildings; Official Site

senbei-kingdom.name: せんべい王国 (Senbei Kingdom)
senbei-kingdom.description: Free admission; draw & paint your own giant rice cracker + flavoring (weekdays, reservation required); fun hands-on experience; Official Site

otakusen-night.name: Kanbara Shrine – Bandai Taiko + Otakusen Ceremony
otakusen-night.description: 18:30 ★ Bandai Taiko (thunderous drum performance) → 19:00 ★ Otakusen (830-year-old Shinto ritual at Kanbara Shrine Kagura-den; free to watch); festival stalls open late; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

kahara-final.name: Kanbara Festival – Final Day
kahara-final.description: Final day; stalls, Great Daikoku dance offering (15:00); Bandai Taiko already watched on night of 7/1 — depart for Tokyo after Daikoku; free; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

niigata-haneda-transit.name: Niigata → Tokyo (Shinkansen)
niigata-haneda-transit.description: Joetsu Shinkansen toward Tokyo; ~100 min; arrive early evening with plenty of time to check in and have dinner

ginza-hotel.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza – Check-in
ginza-hotel.description: 2-15-13 Tsukiji; arrive early evening — time to check in and enjoy dinner around Higashi-Ginza; Tsukiji market and Day 7 sights nearby; Official Site

movement-niigata-to-kawagoe.name: Niigata → Omiya → Kawagoe (transit)
movement-niigata-to-kawagoe.description: Joetsu Shinkansen Niigata→Omiya (~1h40min) → JR Kawagoe Line Omiya→Kawagoe (~30min); total ~2h10min; faster than routing via central Tokyo; rest on the train

kawagoe-hikawa-shrine.name: 🌸 Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine
kawagoe-hikawa-shrine.description: Kawagoe's beloved matchmaking shrine; 2-11-3 Miyashita-cho; ~20 min walk from Kawagoe Stn East Exit; precincts adorned with wind chimes and enpmusubi (love-tying) balls; free; Official Site

kawagoe-kurazukuri-taisho.name: 🏛️ Kurazukuri Street + Taisho Roman Yume-dori (incl. lunch)
kawagoe-kurazukuri-taisho.description: Kawagoe's main historic street; Important Preservation District; rows of Edo-period clay-walled storehouses (kurazukuri); Taisho Roman Yume-dori runs between Nakacho and Renjakucho with retro Taisho-era shopfronts; street food + lunch included; Kawagoe Tourism Assoc.

kawagoe-tokinokane-starbucks.name: ⏰ Toki no Kane Bell Tower + Starbucks Kawagoe
kawagoe-tokinokane-starbucks.description: 15-7 Saiwai-cho; 400-year-old bell tower; chimes 4 times daily (06:00 · 12:00 · 15:00 · 18:00); adjacent Starbucks occupies a restored kurazukuri storehouse — one of Japan's most photographed Starbucks; terrace seating available; Toki no Kane Info

kawagoe-kashiya-chiikawa.name: 🍬 Kashiya Yokocho + Chiikawa MOGUMOGU Kawagoe
kawagoe-kashiya-chiikawa.description: Moto-machi 2-chome; cobblestone lane of ~20 old-fashioned candy shops dating to the Meiji era; designated 'Fragrant Landscape 100' by Japan's Ministry of Environment; 🐾 Chiikawa Mogumogu Honpo Kawagoe (2-7-9 Moto-machi): Kawagoe-exclusive goods & snacks; weekday = less crowded, no reservation needed (since May 2025); open 09:30–17:30; MOGUMOGU Official

kawagoe-matsuri-kaikan.name: 🎪 Kawagoe Matsuri Kaikan (Festival Museum)
kawagoe-matsuri-kaikan.description: 2-1-10 Moto-machi; UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage — Kawagoe Festival floats (dashi) and float culture displayed up close; open 09:30–18:30 (Apr–Sep); closed Tuesdays (7/2 is Thursday ✅); Official Site

movement-kawagoe-to-higashiginza.name: Kawagoe → Via Inn Higashi-Ginza (transit)
movement-kawagoe-to-higashiginza.description: Tobu Tojo Line Express Kawagoe→Ikebukuro (~30 min) → Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line Hibiya→Higashi-Ginza (~30 min); total ~1h10min; arrive at hotel ~16:45

tsukiji-market.name: Tsukiji Outer Market (築地場外市場)
tsukiji-market.description: Breakfast recommended; 5 min walk; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi; open from 06:00; morning = freshest produce and best atmosphere; Official Site

tsukiji-honganji.name: Tsukiji Honganji Temple
tsukiji-honganji.description: 10 min walk; free; striking Indian-style Buddhist architecture; beautiful in morning light

kabuki-za.name: Kabuki-za – Curtain-View Seat (幕見席)
kabuki-za.description: July Grand Kabuki (7/2–7/26); Matinée 11:00; Recommended 幕見: Suehirogari (1st act, short celebratory dance); 4F single-act seating; English audio guide ¥1,000/unit; no photography during performance; photos allowed during intermission; Curtain-View Tickets · July Programme

senso-ji.name: Senso-ji Temple, Kaminarimon & Nakamise
senso-ji.description: Tokyo's most visited temple; free; iconic Kaminarimon thunder gate; Nakamise shopping street; morning = fewer crowds; Official Site

higashi-hongan-ji.name: Higashi Hongan-ji (Asakusa)
higashi-hongan-ji.description: Free; West Asakusa 1-5-5; 5 min walk from Senso-ji; peaceful alternative temple worth a quick visit; Official Site

samurai-ninja.name: Samurai Ninja Museum Asakusa
samurai-ninja.description: English-guided tour; armour wearing + shuriken throwing; ~60 min; 3 min walk from Higashi Hongan-ji; pre-book online; Book Online

kappabashi-tanabata.name: 🎋 Kappabashi – Shitamachi Tanabata Festival
kappabashi-tanabata.description: Bamboo Tanabata decorations, food stalls; 1.2km from Showa-dori to Kokusai-dori; 5 min from Samurai Ninja Museum; free strolling; Asakusa Tourism / Official Site / ▶ YouTube

movement-asakusa-to-hotel.name: Asakusa → Hotel (Higashi-Ginza) [transit]
movement-asakusa-to-hotel.description: Hibiya Line Asakusa→Higashi-Ginza; ~20 min; early return to prep for next day

hotel-rest-evening-3.name: Hotel Rest + Dinner + Early Sleep
hotel-rest-evening-3.description: Return to Via Inn Higashi-Ginza; rest, pack bags; dinner 17:30–19:00; early sleep to be fresh for Akihabara day

tsukiji-market-morning.name: Tsukiji Market (Quick Breakfast)
tsukiji-market-morning.description: Quick breakfast before checkout; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi; open from 06:00; Official Site

hotel-checkout-4.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza – Checkout + Luggage Storage
hotel-checkout-4.description: Check out; leave luggage with hotel storage; complete by 10:00

akihabara-lunch-afternoon.name: ★ Akihabara Lunch + Area Explore
akihabara-lunch-afternoon.description: Enter Akihabara; lunch choice (ramen, teishoku, conveyor sushi); first explore of the electronics district

akiba-fukurou-owl-cafe-4.name: 🦉 Akiba Fukurou Owl Cafe
akiba-fukurou-owl-cafe-4.description: Owl interaction experience; must pre-book; cash only; cute owls, photos, food & drink; 1-hr session in Akihabara; Info

akihabara-afternoon-shopping.name: Akihabara Shopping & Exploring
akihabara-afternoon-shopping.description: After Owl Cafe; browse electronics street, game arcades, figure shops, anime goods; classic Akihabara experience

movement-akiba-to-minato.name: Akihabara → Minatomirai (transit)
movement-akiba-to-minato.description: Hibiya Line Akihabara→Higashi-Ginza (collect luggage) → JR to Yokohama direction; ~50 min total; heading to Aka-Renga

minato-light-meal-rest.name: Minatomirai – Light Meal & Rest
minato-light-meal-rest.description: Brief rest after arriving in Minatomirai; light snack or meal to recharge

akarenga.name: 赤レンガ倉庫 (Red Brick Warehouse) + Harbour Walk
akarenga.description: Free; photogenic Meiji-era red brick warehouses; Yokohama harbour scenery; beautiful in late afternoon light; Official Site

movement-minato-to-shinyoko.name: Minatomirai → Shin-Yokohama (transit)
movement-minato-to-shinyoko.description: Minatomirai Line→Yokohama Line; ~20 min; check in at Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama on arrival

shinyoko-hotel.name: Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama – Check-in
shinyoko-hotel.description: Natural hot spring bath; free breakfast; 10–12 min walk to Nissan Stadium; check in, rest, freshen up

movement-hotel-to-stadium.name: Hotel → Nissan Stadium (walk)
movement-hotel-to-stadium.description: 10–12 min walk; arrive early to queue for merchandise; bring towel, water, sunscreen (outdoor venue)

ado-1.name: Ado Concert – Night 1 (Nissan Stadium)
ado-1.description: Nissan Stadium (~72,000 capacity); large outdoor concert; tickets confirmed; wait 30–45 min after show before leaving (crowd management)

yamashita-park.name: 山下公園 (Yamashita Park)
yamashita-park.description: Free; panoramic Yokohama Harbour views; seaside promenade; stroll and take photos

osaka-daisan-bashi.name: 大さん橋 (Osanbashi – Yokohama International Pier)
osaka-daisan-bashi.description: Free; Yokohama International Cruise Terminal; dramatic curved wooden rooftop terrace with sweeping harbour views; one of Yokohama's most beautiful spots

motomachi.name: 元町ショッピングストリート (Motomachi)
motomachi.description: Yokohama's historic upscale shopping street; stylish boutiques, cafés, pastry shops; foreign settlement atmosphere

cup-noodles.name: カップヌードルミュージアム (Cup Noodles Museum)
cup-noodles.description: Hands-on food museum; create your own original Cup Noodle flavour; Chicken Ramen factory workshop; fun for all ages; Official Site
cup-noodles.price: Adult ¥500 · Under 12 free; Custom Cup Noodle +¥500; Chicken Ramen workshop +¥500

air-cabin.name: YOKOHAMA AIR CABIN
air-cabin.description: Cable car ride over the canal; Unga Park Stn → Sakuragi-cho Stn; ~5 min scenic aerial ride

bandai-namco-cross-store.name: 🎮 Bandai Namco Cross Store Yokohama
bandai-namco-cross-store.description: Yokohama World Porters 2F; 1 min from Unga Park Stn; 20+ official shops (Gundam, JoJo, etc.); Gashapon corner; amusement area; free entry; Official Site

movement-minato-to-shinyoko-2.name: Minatomirai → Shin-Yokohama (return)
movement-minato-to-shinyoko-2.description: Minatomirai Line→Yokohama Line; ~25 min; return to hotel; rest up for Night 2 concert

ado-2.name: Ado Concert – Night 2 (Nissan Stadium)
ado-2.description: Nissan Stadium; tickets confirmed; wait after show; prepare for tomorrow's checkout

shinyoko-checkout.name: Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama – Early Checkout
shinyoko-checkout.description: Early checkout; pack luggage; heading to Kawasaki Daishi

haneda-luggage.name: Haneda Airport – Luggage Storage
haneda-luggage.description: Storage at any terminal; collect before departure

kawasaki-daishi.name: 川崎大師 Kawasaki Daishi (Heiken-ji Temple)
kawasaki-daishi.description: Founded 1128; one of Japan's top 3 most-visited temples; worship + Nakamise-dori shopping approach; traditional sweets and crafts; Info

nakamise-dori.name: 仲見世通り (Nakamise Shopping Street)
nakamise-dori.description: Temple approach shopping street; traditional crafts, souvenirs, food; last Japan shopping before departure

kawasaki-yakuyoke-mon.name: 📸 Kawasaki Daishi – Yakuyoke-mon Gate (大山門)
kawasaki-yakuyoke-mon.description: Iconic vermillion main gate at the Nakamise-dori entrance; symbol of Kawasaki Daishi; quick photo stop only; free

haneda-return.name: Haneda Airport – International Departure
haneda-return.description: Collect luggage + duty-free shopping + check-in + immigration; arrive at airport by 13:30

movement-hotel-to-akihabara-27.name: Takeiba → Akihabara (transit)
movement-hotel-to-akihabara-27.description: Toei Asakusa Line from Daimon Stn → transfer to Hibiya Line → Akihabara; ~20 min

akihabara-morning-27.name: ⚡ Akihabara – Morning Explore
akihabara-morning-27.description: Electronics town, anime district, gacha machines, arcades; Yodobashi Camera, Akihabara Radio Center, Mandarake; explore at leisure; Akihabara Info

akihabara-lunch-27.name: 🍽️ Akihabara Lunch
akihabara-lunch-27.description: Free choice around the electronics district; ramen, set meals, conveyor sushi; refuel before afternoon activities

akiba-fukurou-27.name: 🦉 Akiba Fukurou Owl Café [Recommended – Pre-book]
akiba-fukurou-27.description: Interactive owl experience; must pre-book online before trip; cash only; 1-hr session; ⚠️ Saturday is busy — book early; Info

akihabara-shopping-27.name: 🎮 Akihabara – Afternoon Shopping
akihabara-shopping-27.description: Electronics street, arcades, model shops, figure stores, Gunpla; classic Akihabara experience

ueno-ameyoko-optional-27.name: 🌳 Ueno Park + Ameyoko Market [Flexible]
ueno-ameyoko-optional-27.description: [Optional] 10 min walk or 1 JR stop from Akihabara; Ueno Onshi Park, Shinobazu Pond, Ameya-Yokocho market (post-war black market vibes); free to explore

movement-return-hotel-27.name: Akihabara / Ueno → Hotel (return)
movement-return-hotel-27.description: JR Yamanote Line Ueno→Hamamatsucho or Hibiya Line Akihabara→Daimon; ~20 min; return to Hotel Tabinos; ⚠️ Doraemon ticket reminder: buy 7-Eleven マルチコピー paper ticket for 7/04 show; Sat price: Adult ¥2,600, Student ¥2,000 (age 16 no student card → Adult ¥2,600)

hotel-checkout-28.name: 🔔 Hotel Tabinos Checkout + Luggage Storage
hotel-checkout-28.description: Check out; store luggage with hotel (confirm service hours); tonight’s hotel TBD — recommend area near teamLab (Azabudai Hills) or Tokyo Stn (Shinkansen next morning 6/29)

movement-to-tsukiji-28.name: Takeiba → Tsukiji (transit)
movement-to-tsukiji-28.description: Toei Asakusa Line Daimon→Tsukiji; ~15 min; head to outer market

tsukiji-market-28.name: 🐟 Tsukiji Outer Market (morning)
tsukiji-market-28.description: Morning breakfast; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi bowls; open from 06:00; peak freshness early morning; Official Site

tsukiji-honganji-28.name: ⛩️ Tsukiji Honganji Temple
tsukiji-honganji-28.description: 5 min walk from outer market; free; striking Indian-style Buddhist architecture; Jodo Shinshu Nishi-Honganjiha; Official Site

movement-tsukiji-to-asakusa-28.name: Tsukiji → Asakusa (transit)
movement-tsukiji-to-asakusa-28.description: Hibiya Line toward Ueno direction or Ginza Line to Asakusa; ~30 min; heading to Shitamachi

senso-ji-28.name: ⛩️ Senso-ji, Kaminarimon & Nakamise
senso-ji-28.description: Tokyo’s oldest temple; free; iconic Kaminarimon thunder gate; Nakamise shopping arcade (~250m); omiyage, ningyo-yaki, kaminari-okoshi; Official Site

higashi-hongan-ji-28.name: ⛩️ Higashi Hongan-ji (Asakusa)
higashi-hongan-ji-28.description: Free; West Asakusa 1-5-5; 5 min walk from Senso-ji; peaceful Jodo Shinshu temple; Official Site

asakusa-lunch-28.name: 🍽️ Asakusa Lunch
asakusa-lunch-28.description: Free choice around Asakusa; old-school tempura, dojo, monjayaki; refuel before afternoon activities

samurai-ninja-28.name: 🥷 Samurai Ninja Museum Asakusa [Recommended – Pre-book]
samurai-ninja-28.description: English-guided tour; armour wearing + shuriken throwing; ~60 min; pre-book online recommended; 3 min walk from Higashi Hongan-ji; Book Online

asakusa-afternoon-28.name: 🚶 Asakusa – Free Afternoon
asakusa-afternoon-28.description: Asakusa Culture Tourist Information Center, Denpo-in-dori, Rokku Broadway; stroll shitamachi at your own pace

movement-to-hotel-28.name: Asakusa → Tonight’s Hotel (TBD)
movement-to-hotel-28.description: Head to 6/28 hotel (TBD); recommend area near teamLab Borderless (Azabudai Hills / Roppongi) or Tokyo Stn; ⚠️ teamLab 08:30 entry tomorrow (6/29) — sleep early

movement-ginza-to-divercity-702.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza → DiverCity Tokyo
movement-ginza-to-divercity-702.description: Higashi-Ginza → Toei Asakusa Line → Shimbashi → Yurikamome → Aomi Stn; ~35–40 min; heading to Odaiba DiverCity

divercity-dinner-702.name: 🍽️ DiverCity Dinner
divercity-dinner-702.description: Wide range of restaurants inside DiverCity mall; relax with a good meal; ⚠️ today is the longest day (~12–13 hrs); rest before Gundam show; DiverCity Official

gundam-night-702.name: 🌃 Unicorn Gundam Night Show [Recommended 20:00]
gundam-night-702.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE — retiring end of August 2026 (nearly 9 years)! Free; WALL-G shows every 30 min (19:00–21:30); 20:00 = UNICORN Special Movie (recommended); Official Site

aqua-symphony-optional-702.name: 💦 Tokyo Aqua Symphony [Optional – 21:00]
aqua-symphony-optional-702.description: [Optional] 15–20 min walk after Gundam show; free; Odaiba Marine Park; if energy allows add this on; if tired, head straight back to hotel; Official Site

movement-return-hotel-702.name: Aomi → Via Inn Higashi-Ginza (return)
movement-return-hotel-702.description: Yurikamome Aomi→Shimbashi → Toei Asakusa Line → Higashi-Ginza; ~30 min; return to hotel and rest

hotel-breakfast-703.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-703.description: Hotel breakfast; fuel up for a full day: Meiji Shrine → Harajuku → Kichijoji → Shinjuku

movement-viain-to-sangubashi-703.name: Via Inn → Sangubashi Stn (transit)
movement-viain-to-sangubashi-703.description: Hibiya Line Higashi-Ginza → Chiyoda Line direction Meiji-jingumae → Sangubashi Stn; ~20 min; heading to Meiji Shrine north entrance

movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north-703.name: Sangubashi → Meiji Shrine North Gate (walk)
movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north-703.description: Walk ~30 min through greenery to the north entrance of Meiji Shrine

meiji-shrine-703.name: ⛩️ Meiji Shrine – Forest Walk
meiji-shrine-703.description: Japan's most important Shinto shrine; free; enter north gate, exit east; serene forested path; peaceful contrast to the city; Official Site

omotesando-703.name: 🚶 Omotesando (表參道)
omotesando-703.description: Tokyo's premier upscale shopping street; LV, Gucci, Prada flagships; beautiful architecture; connects directly from Meiji Shrine east exit

movement-omotesando-to-takeshita-703.name: Omotesando → Takeshita-dori (walk)
movement-omotesando-to-takeshita-703.description: 10–15 min walk; from Omotesando area straight to Takeshita-dori entrance

harajuku-takeshita-703.name: 🚶 Takeshita-dori – 60 min
harajuku-takeshita-703.description: World-famous Harajuku youth fashion street; H&M, Forever 21, indie shops, crepes, accessories; lively crowds; eat & browse; Info

harajuku-lunch-703.name: 🍽️ Harajuku Lunch [Flexible]
harajuku-lunch-703.description: Free choice around Takeshita-dori or Omotesando; Eggs 'n Things, BAPE Cafe and many options; refuel before heading to Kichijoji

movement-harajuku-to-kichijoji-703.name: Harajuku → Kichijoji (transit)
movement-harajuku-to-kichijoji-703.description: JR Yamanote Line Harajuku→Shibuya (1 stop, ~2 min) → Keio Inokashira Line Shibuya→Kichijoji (Express, ~26 min); ~30 min total, 1 transfer

kichijoji-petitmura-temarinooshiro-703.name: 🏰 Kichijoji Petit Mura + CAPOON + Temari no Oshiro Cat Café (Weekday)
kichijoji-petitmura-temarinooshiro-703.description: Fairy-tale village complex; 2-33-2 Kichijoji Honcho, Musashino; 7-min walk from North Exit; 🍵 CAPOON Matcha: stone-ground matcha drinks & desserts; 🏰 Temari no Oshiro (Castle Cat Café): ~20 cats, 2-storey castle; ⚠️ Weekday pricing TBC (weekend ¥1,800/person); walk-ins welcome; 10:00–21:00; Official Site

movement-kichijoji-north-to-south-703.name: Kichijoji North Exit → South Exit (walk)
movement-kichijoji-north-to-south-703.description: Walk from Petit Mura (North Exit area) to café street (South Exit area); ~15 min

kichijoji-soratobusakana-703.name: ☕ Kuusougai Café — Flying Fish (Afternoon Tea)
kichijoji-soratobusakana-703.description: Fantasy-themed café; 2-34-9 Kichijoji Honcho; 7-min walk from South Exit (Park Exit) along Nakamichi-dori; picture-book atelier concept; specialty drinks & desserts; open 11:00–19:00; Info article

kichijoji-inokashira-park-703.name: 🌿 Inokashira Park – Lakeside Stroll [Flexible]
kichijoji-inokashira-park-703.description: 5-min walk from Flying Fish Café; free entry; lakeside walk + optional swan boat rental; most scenic natural spot in Kichijoji; Park Info

movement-kichijoji-to-shinjuku-703.name: Kichijoji → Shinjuku West (transit)
movement-kichijoji-to-shinjuku-703.description: JR Chuo Line (Rapid) Kichijoji→Shinjuku (~22 min); 1-min walk to Kagawa Ippuku; ~30 min total

shinjuku-kagawa-ippuku-703.name: 🍜 Kagawa Ippuku Nishi-Shinjuku (Dinner)
shinjuku-kagawa-ippuku-703.description: Sanuki udon specialty; 7-9-15 Nishi-Shinjuku; 1-min walk from Toei Oedo Line Shinjuku-Nishiguchi D5 exit; Friday 11:00–21:30 (last order 21:00); Official Site

movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae-703.name: Nishi-Shinjuku → Tochomae (after dinner)
movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae-703.description: Walk ~10–12 min (~850m) from Kagawa Ippuku; or Toei Oedo Line Shinjuku-Nishiguchi→Tochomae (1 stop, ~3 min); must arrive by 20:00

tokyo-night-light-703.name: ✨ Tokyo Night Light – Shinjuku Projection Mapping [Must-see]
tokyo-night-light-703.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building (directly at Tochomae Stn); massive outdoor projection mapping show; every night 20:00–21:00; free; breathtaking light art; Official Site

movement-return-viain-703.name: Tochomae → Via Inn Higashi-Ginza (return)
movement-return-viain-703.description: Marunouchi Line Tochomae→Ginza → Hibiya Line Higashi-Ginza; ~25 min; return to hotel and rest

hotel-breakfast-704.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-704.description: Hotel breakfast; fuel up — today is a moving day with packed schedule: SMALL WORLDS → Toyosu → Doraemon → Shin-Yokohama → Ado Concert

hotel-checkout-704.name: 🔔 Via Inn Higashi-Ginza Checkout + Luggage Storage
hotel-checkout-704.description: Check out; hotel stores luggage until ~17:00 (collect before heading to Shin-Yokohama); complete checkout by 10:00; ⚠️ [Optional: Kabuki-za Makumiseki] hotel is 3-min walk to Kabuki-za — if time allows, queue for “Suehirogari” curtain-view seat (11:00, ~30 min); doing so pushes SMALL WORLDS to 12:00 — decide based on energy; Curtain-View Tickets

movement-viain-to-ariake-704.name: Via Inn Higashi-Ginza → Ariake Tennis-no-Mori (transit)
movement-viain-to-ariake-704.description: Higashi-Ginza Stn → Shimbashi → Yurikamome → Ariake Tennis-no-Mori Stn; ~30 min; heading to SMALL WORLDS

small-worlds-704.name: 🎮 SMALL WORLDS TOKYO
small-worlds-704.description: World's largest miniature theme park; 3 min from Ariake Tennis-no-Mori Stn; 3 hrs recommended; intricate diorama displays; ⚠️ pre-book online (Saturday is busy); Official Site

movement-ariake-to-ichiba-704.name: Ariake Tennis-no-Mori → Ichiba-mae (Yurikamome)
movement-ariake-to-ichiba-704.description: Yurikamome; very short ~5 min; direct to Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara

toyosu-sengyoku-704.name: 🍱 Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara (Lunch)
toyosu-sengyoku-704.description: Gourmet food hall 4 min from Ichiba-mae Stn; fresh seafood, rice bowls, soba; ~1.5 hrs dining; Official Site

movement-ichiba-to-ariake-704.name: Ichiba-mae → Ariake Tennis-no-Mori (Yurikamome)
movement-ichiba-to-ariake-704.description: Yurikamome; ~5 min return after lunch; back to Tokyo Dream Park

tokyo-dream-park-704.name: 🎡 Tokyo Dream Park – Doraemon Exhibition
tokyo-dream-park-704.description: 3-min walk from Ariake Tennis-no-Mori; 100% Doraemon Exhibition; ⚠️ buy paper ticket at any 7-Eleven マルチコピー machine between 6/27 and 7/03; Official Site

movement-ariake-to-viain-704.name: Ariake → Via Inn Higashi-Ginza (collect luggage)
movement-ariake-to-viain-704.description: Yurikamome → Shimbashi → Toei Asakusa Line → Higashi-Ginza; ~30 min; collect stored luggage from hotel

movement-viain-to-shinyoko-704.name: Higashi-Ginza → Shin-Yokohama (transit)
movement-viain-to-shinyoko-704.description: Higashi-Ginza→Shinagawa→JR Tokaido Line→Yokohama→JR Yokohama Line→Shin-Yokohama; ~45–50 min; check in at Super Hotel on arrival
